c8.name: The Role Behind the Posting
c8.cr: Saw the {role_title} opening on your team. Would like to connect.
c8.m1:
Thanks for connecting, {first_name}.

Is the {role_title} role in {location} still open?

It reads like {key_skills} experience matters most, and Elite Technical works on IT and engineering searches like it.
c8.m2: Is the harder part of that role finding {key_skills} together in one person, or keeping good candidates engaged through your process?
c8.m3: Asking because we handle those two problems differently. We can run a complimentary talent availability assessment on this role, covering who is available, what the market looks like and what a realistic timeline is. Would a brief 15-minute call work?
c8.yes: Thank you, {first_name}. We will look at the {role_title} role and send back availability, market conditions and a timeline. Or grab 15 minutes here: {meeting_link}

c9.name: Candidate Fraud in Technical Hiring
c9.cr: Saw the technical hiring happening on your team. Would like to connect.
c9.m1:
Thanks for connecting, {first_name}.

Candidate misrepresentation is becoming a bigger issue in technical hiring, especially for remote roles.

Elite Technical built InterviewMyCandidate to add video interviews and identity verification before a candidate reaches a hiring manager. We have placed over 4,500 professionals in 34 years.

Open to a conversation on what you are seeing.
c9.m2: Have you run into a candidate who did not match their résumé once they reached a technical interview?
c9.m3: Asking because if you have, the cost was probably higher than a screening step would have been. We can give you a complimentary AI-powered candidate screening experience so you can see it firsthand. Would a brief 15-minute call next week work?
c9.yes: Happy to set it up, {first_name}. We will walk you through the video interview, the identity verification and the AI-generated interview summary. Grab 15 minutes here: {meeting_link}

c10.name: New Seat, Fresh Team
c10.cr: Congratulations on the new {new_role} role. Would like to connect.
c10.m1:
Thanks for connecting, {first_name}.

New leaders often inherit open roles and a hiring process they did not design.

Elite Technical has supported IT and engineering hiring for 34 years, and our candidate submissions include a video interview and identity verification step.

Open to a conversation if building out the team is part of your first year.
c10.m2: As you settle in, is the bigger priority filling the roles already open or reshaping the team for what comes next?
c10.m3: Asking because one needs speed and the other needs a clearer picture of available talent. We can run a complimentary talent availability assessment on your hardest role to fill. Would a brief 15-minute call work?
c10.yes: Thank you, {first_name}. Tell me the role you would fill first and we will send back availability and a realistic timeline. Or grab 15 minutes here: {meeting_link}

c2.name: Engineers for the Program Ramp
c2.cr: Saw your team is scaling engineering around {program_or_product}. Would like to connect.
c2.m1:
Thanks for connecting, {first_name}.

Elite Technical pairs AI-powered recruiting with recruiters who specialize in engineering roles, which gets us to niche talent faster than a generic search.

We have been doing this for 34 years.

Open to a conversation if hiring for {engineering_focus} is a priority this year.
c2.m2: Is the bottleneck usually finding enough qualified engineers at all, or getting good candidates through your process before they accept elsewhere?
c2.m3: Asking because the first is a sourcing problem and the second is a speed problem, and we approach them differently. We can run a complimentary talent availability assessment on one of your toughest engineering roles. Worth a brief 15-minute call?
c2.yes: Thank you, {first_name}. Tell me which engineering role is hardest to fill and where it sits, and we will send back availability, market conditions and a realistic timeline. Or grab 15 minutes here: {meeting_link}

c3.name: Hiring Security Talent Without the Fraud Risk
c3.cr: Saw your team is growing its security engineering group. Would like to connect.
c3.m1:
Thanks for connecting, {first_name}.

For a security company, hiring someone who misrepresented themselves is a real risk.

Elite Technical adds video interviews and identity verification to our candidate submissions through our InterviewMyCandidate platform. We have worked with over 400 clients across IT and engineering.

Open to a conversation on how you verify {security_focus} candidates today.
c3.m2: When a strong security candidate reaches your team, who verifies their claims first, your recruiters or the hiring manager?
c3.m3: Asking because if it falls on the hiring manager, it is usually the most expensive place to catch a problem. We can give you a complimentary AI-powered candidate screening experience so you can see how it works firsthand. Would a brief 15-minute call next week work?
c3.yes: Happy to set it up, {first_name}. We will walk you through the full flow: the video interview, the identity verification and the AI-generated interview summary. Grab 15 minutes here: {meeting_link}
